name: Hypebeast
eras: 2010s peak with drop culture and resale markets
places: Hypebeast.com (the media outlet the subculture is named for)

media.title: Hypebeast (media site, founded 2005)
media.note: the outlet the whole look is named after

reacts_against: quiet, logo-free taste; hypebeast dressing is explicitly about visible, legible status and scarcity, not subtlety.

wiki_facts.key_motifs: Prominent brand logos, limited-edition sneakers, graphic prints, artist/brand collaborations
wiki_facts.key_values: Exclusivity, brand consciousness, social status, trend-following, conspicuous consumption

findings: dark — about 41% of the measured color across 6 wiki images is below mid-lightness
mostly muted — about 86% of the measured color is low-saturation (greys, dusty tones)
measured.caveat: Colors measured from Aesthetics Wiki photos as photographed and displayed on screen; actual garments and materials vary, and screen colors are approximate.
